questions.stem_md: Koordinata tekisligida $A(-1;-10)$, $B(-1;-4)$ va $C(7;-4)$ nuqtalar berilgan. $ABC$ uchburchak uchun quyidagilarni toping.

a.hint: Javobni butun son, oddiy kasr yoki o'nli kasr (nuqta bilan) ko'rinishida yozing.

b.prompt_md: Uchburchakka ichki chizilgan aylananing radiusini toping.
b.hint: Javobni butun son, oddiy kasr yoki o'nli kasr (nuqta bilan) ko'rinishida yozing.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="80,170 80,50 240,50" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><circle cx="80" cy="170" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="80" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="240" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="66.7" y="190" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A(-1;-10)</text><text x="59.2" y="34.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B(-1;-4)</text><text x="264.3" y="40.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C(7;-4)</text></svg>
figure.alt: Koordinata tekisligidagi ABC uchburchak: A(-1; -10), B(-1; -4), C(7; -4).

questions.solution_md:
$B$ va $C$ nuqtalarning ordinatalari teng ($-4$), shuning uchun $BC\parallel Ox$ va $BC=|7-(-1)|=8$. $A$ nuqtadan $BC$ gacha masofa $h=|-10-(-4)|=6$.

a) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 8\cdot 6=24$.

b) Tomonlar: $AB=\sqrt{(-1-(-1))^2+(-10-(-4))^2}=6$, $AC=\sqrt{(-1-7)^2+(-10-(-4))^2}=10$. Yarim perimetr $p=\dfrac{6+8+10}{2}=12$.

Ichki chizilgan aylana radiusi: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{24}{12}=2$.
questions.mistake_note_md: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}$ da $p$ — yarim perimetr ekanini unutib, butun perimetrni qo'yish; yoki $BC$ ga balandlikni noto'g'ri hisoblash.

ru.stem_md: На координатной плоскости заданы точки $A(-1;-10)$, $B(-1;-4)$ и $C(7;-4)$. Для треугольника $ABC$ найдите следующее.

a.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом, обыкновенной или десятичной дробью (через точку).

b.prompt_md: Найдите радиус вписанной в треугольник окружности.
b.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом, обыкновенной или десятичной дробью (через точку).

ru.solution_md:
Ординаты точек $B$ и $C$ равны ($-4$), поэтому $BC\parallel Ox$ и $BC=|7-(-1)|=8$. Расстояние от $A$ до $BC$: $h=|-10-(-4)|=6$.

а) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 8\cdot 6=24$.

б) Стороны: $AB=\sqrt{(-1-(-1))^2+(-10-(-4))^2}=6$, $AC=\sqrt{(-1-7)^2+(-10-(-4))^2}=10$. Полупериметр $p=\dfrac{6+8+10}{2}=12$.

Радиус вписанной окружности: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{24}{12}=2$.
ru.mistake_note_md: В формуле $r=\dfrac{S}{p}$ подставляют весь периметр вместо полупериметра либо неверно находят высоту к $BC$.

questions.stem_md: $AB$ kesmaning o'rtasi $M(9;14)$, $A$ nuqta esa $(1;-1)$ koordinatalarga ega. $AB$ kesmaning uzunligini toping.
questions.solution_md:
$M$ — $AB$ ning o'rtasi, demak $B=2M-A$. $B$ nuqtaning koordinatalari: $2\cdot 9-1=17$ va $2\cdot 14-(-1)=29$.

$AB=\sqrt{(17-1)^2+(29-(-1))^2}=\sqrt{256+900}=34$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Faqat $AM$ ni topib to'xtash (u $AB$ ning yarmi) yoki kvadrat ildiz olishni unutish.

ru.mistake_note_md: Находят только $AM$ (это половина $AB$) или забывают извлечь квадратный корень.

kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek $AM$ di tabıp toqtaw (ol $AB$ nıń yarımı) yamasa kvadrat túbir shıǵarıwdı umıtıw.

en.stem_md: The midpoint of segment $AB$ is $M(9;14)$ and the point $A$ has coordinates $(1;-1)$. Find the length of segment $AB$.
en.solution_md:
$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot 9-1=17$ and $2\cdot 14-(-1)=29$.

$AB=\sqrt{(17-1)^2+(29-(-1))^2}=\sqrt{256+900}=34$.
en.mistake_note_md: Stopping after finding $AM$ (which is half of $AB$) or forgetting the square root.

questions.stem_md: $AB$ kesmaning o'rtasi $M(-18;8)$, $A$ nuqta esa $(-3;0)$ koordinatalarga ega. $AB$ kesmaning uzunligini toping.
questions.solution_md:
$M$ — $AB$ ning o'rtasi, demak $B=2M-A$. $B$ nuqtaning koordinatalari: $2\cdot (-18)-(-3)=-33$ va $2\cdot 8-0=16$.

$AB=\sqrt{(-33-(-3))^2+(16-0)^2}=\sqrt{900+256}=34$.

en.stem_md: The midpoint of segment $AB$ is $M(-18;8)$ and the point $A$ has coordinates $(-3;0)$. Find the length of segment $AB$.
en.solution_md:
$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot (-18)-(-3)=-33$ and $2\cdot 8-0=16$.

$AB=\sqrt{(-33-(-3))^2+(16-0)^2}=\sqrt{900+256}=34$.
en.mistake_note_md: Stopping after finding $AM$ (which is half of $AB$) or forgetting the square root.

ru.solution_md:
Ординаты точек $B$ и $C$ равны ($2$), поэтому $BC\parallel Ox$ и $BC=|25-1|=24$. Расстояние от $A$ до $BC$: $h=|-3-2|=5$.

а) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 24\cdot 5=60$.

б) Стороны: $AB=\sqrt{(13-1)^2+(-3-2)^2}=13$, $AC=\sqrt{(13-25)^2+(-3-2)^2}=13$. Полупериметр $p=\dfrac{13+24+13}{2}=25$.

Радиус вписанной окружности: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{60}{25}=\frac{12}{5}$.

questions.stem_md: $AB$ kesmaning o'rtasi $M(6;-6)$, $A$ nuqta esa $(2;-3)$ koordinatalarga ega. $AB$ kesmaning uzunligini toping.

$M$ — $AB$ ning o'rtasi, demak $B=2M-A$. $B$ nuqtaning koordinatalari: $2\cdot 6-2=10$ va $2\cdot (-6)-(-3)=-9$.

en.stem_md: The midpoint of segment $AB$ is $M(6;-6)$ and the point $A$ has coordinates $(2;-3)$. Find the length of segment $AB$.
en.solution_md:
$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot 6-2=10$ and $2\cdot (-6)-(-3)=-9$.

$AB=\sqrt{(10-2)^2+(-9-(-3))^2}=\sqrt{64+36}=10$.

en.solution_md:
$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot 9-3=15$ and $2\cdot 13-5=21$.

$AB=\sqrt{(15-3)^2+(21-5)^2}=\sqrt{144+256}=20$.

en.solution_md:
The ordinates of $B$ and $C$ are equal ($-2$), so $BC\parallel Ox$ and $BC=|28-4|=24$. The distance from $A$ to $BC$ is $h=|-7-(-2)|=5$.

a) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 24\cdot 5=60$.

b) Sides: $AB=\sqrt{(16-4)^2+(-7-(-2))^2}=13$, $AC=\sqrt{(16-28)^2+(-7-(-2))^2}=13$. Semiperimeter $p=\dfrac{13+24+13}{2}=25$.

Inradius: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{60}{25}=\frac{12}{5}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the whole perimeter instead of the semiperimeter in $r=\dfrac{S}{p}$, or computing the height to $BC$ incorrectly.

questions.stem_md: $AB$ kesmaning o'rtasi $M(-10;10)$, $A$ nuqta esa $(-2;4)$ koordinatalarga ega. $AB$ kesmaning uzunligini toping.
questions.solution_md:
$M$ — $AB$ ning o'rtasi, demak $B=2M-A$. $B$ nuqtaning koordinatalari: $2\cdot (-10)-(-2)=-18$ va $2\cdot 10-4=16$.

$AB=\sqrt{(-18-(-2))^2+(16-4)^2}=\sqrt{256+144}=20$.

en.stem_md: The midpoint of segment $AB$ is $M(-10;10)$ and the point $A$ has coordinates $(-2;4)$. Find the length of segment $AB$.
en.solution_md:
$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot (-10)-(-2)=-18$ and $2\cdot 10-4=16$.

$AB=\sqrt{(-18-(-2))^2+(16-4)^2}=\sqrt{256+144}=20$.
en.mistake_note_md: Stopping after finding $AM$ (which is half of $AB$) or forgetting the square root.

questions.stem_md: $AB$ kesmaning o'rtasi $M(-18;8)$, $A$ nuqta esa $(-3;0)$ koordinatalarga ega. $AB$ kesmaning uzunligini toping.
questions.solution_md:
$M$ — $AB$ ning o'rtasi, demak $B=2M-A$. $B$ nuqtaning koordinatalari: $2\cdot (-18)-(-3)=-33$ va $2\cdot 8-0=16$.

$AB=\sqrt{(-33-(-3))^2+(16-0)^2}=\sqrt{900+256}=34$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Faqat $AM$ ni topib to'xtash (u $AB$ ning yarmi) yoki kvadrat ildiz olishni unutish.

en.stem_md: The midpoint of segment $AB$ is $M(-18;8)$ and the point $A$ has coordinates $(-3;0)$. Find the length of segment $AB$.
en.solution_md:
$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot (-18)-(-3)=-33$ and $2\cdot 8-0=16$.

$AB=\sqrt{(-33-(-3))^2+(16-0)^2}=\sqrt{900+256}=34$.
en.mistake_note_md: Stopping after finding $AM$ (which is half of $AB$) or forgetting the square root.

questions.stem_md: $AB$ kesmaning o'rtasi $M(2;6)$, $A$ nuqta esa $(-1;2)$ koordinatalarga ega. $AB$ kesmaning uzunligini toping.
questions.solution_md:

а) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 14\cdot 12=84$.

questions.stem_md: $AB$ kesmaning o'rtasi $M(6;-6)$, $A$ nuqta esa $(2;-3)$ koordinatalarga ega. $AB$ kesmaning uzunligini toping.
questions.solution_md:
$M$ — $AB$ ning o'rtasi, demak $B=2M-A$. $B$ nuqtaning koordinatalari: $2\cdot 6-2=10$ va $2\cdot (-6)-(-3)=-9$.

$AB=\sqrt{(10-2)^2+(-9-(-3))^2}=\sqrt{64+36}=10$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Faqat $AM$ ni topib to'xtash (u $AB$ ning yarmi) yoki kvadrat ildiz olishni unutish.

ru.stem_md: Середина отрезка $AB$ — точка $M(6;-6)$, а точка $A$ имеет координаты $(2;-3)$. Найдите длину отрезка $AB$.

en.stem_md: The midpoint of segment $AB$ is $M(6;-6)$ and the point $A$ has coordinates $(2;-3)$. Find the length of segment $AB$.
en.solution_md:
$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot 6-2=10$ and $2\cdot (-6)-(-3)=-9$.

$AB=\sqrt{(10-2)^2+(-9-(-3))^2}=\sqrt{64+36}=10$.
en.mistake_note_md: Stopping after finding $AM$ (which is half of $AB$) or forgetting the square root.

questions.solution_md:
$B$ va $C$ nuqtalarning ordinatalari teng ($3$), shuning uchun $BC\parallel Ox$ va $BC=|5-(-3)|=8$. $A$ nuqtadan $BC$ gacha masofa $h=|-3-3|=6$.

questions.solution_md:
$M$ — $AB$ ning o'rtasi, demak $B=2M-A$. $B$ nuqtaning koordinatalari: $2\cdot (-5)-0=-10$ va $2\cdot 13-1=25$.

$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $B=2M-A$. The coordinates of $B$ are $2\cdot (-5)-0=-10$ and $2\cdot 13-1=25$.

$AB=\sqrt{(-10-0)^2+(25-1)^2}=\sqrt{100+576}=26$.
